extracted.name: Mashed potatoes and Gravy Surprise
extracted.description: Looks like a big pan of gravy but the potatoes are hiding just underneath.
ingredient_lines: 1/4 cup vegetable oil to fry meatballs
To taste ground white pepper powder
instruction_lines: Mix the ingredients for the meatballs. Form into balls and brown the outside till nice and firm. Cook enough to get done. Set aside. Add flour to the oil that the meatballs are fried in add in the butter. Add spices. When the flour is a paste add broth and stir till broth becomes thick. Peel and cube the potatoes boil till fork tender. Drain salt and mash stir in the butter and milk.
Put the potatoes in a large pan add meatballs around in a circle. Then add to center a few meatballs. Add gravy over the top of the mashed potatoes and meatballs.
